function.name: identify_face
function.description: Matches the face in the current frame against a database of ENROLLED users to return a NAME. Use this ONLY when the user asks 'Who is this?' or 'Do you know who this is?'. Do NOT use this to guess age, emotion, or to detect if a generic person is present (use describe_scene for that).

function.name: read_text
function.description: Performs Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract written words from the current view. Use this when the user asks to 'read the sign', 'what is written there', or 'transcribe text'. Do NOT use if the user asks to describe the scene generally.

function.name: detect_gesture
function.description: Analyzes body language to identify specific hand or body movements (e.g., waving, thumbs up, pointing). Use this when the user asks 'did he wave?', 'what gesture is that?', or 'is he signaling?'.

function.name: assess_face_attributes
function.description: Estimates physical characteristics and emotional state (e.g., age, gender, happy, sad) WITHOUT identifying the person by name. Use this when the user asks to 'guess his age', 'does she look happy?', or 'describe their appearance'. Do NOT use to find out a person's name.

function.name: await_motion
function.description: Starts a continuous background monitor to watch for ANY movement. Use this when the user asks to 'let me know if anything moves', 'wait for motion', or 'keep an eye out'. This enables a long-running task.

function.name: stop_monitoring
function.description: Cancels all active background monitoring tasks (motion detection, face waiting, etc.). Use this when the user says 'stop', 'stop watching', 'cancel that', or 'go to sleep'.

function.name: delete_all_faces
function.description: Permanently wipes the entire face database, removing all enrolled users. Use this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to 'delete all faces', 'clear memory', 'reset database', or 'forget everyone'. This is a destructive action.

function.name: classify_sound
function.description: Identifies the CATEGORY of a non-speech sound (e.g., dog barking, siren, glass breaking). Use this when the user asks 'what is that noise?', 'what sound is that?', or 'identify that audio'. Do NOT use for volume levels or speech transcription.

function.name: measure_noise_level
function.description: Measures the volume/intensity of the environment in decibels (dB). Use this when the user asks 'how loud is it?', 'what is the decibel level?', or 'is it noisy?'.

function.name: list_faces
function.description: Returns a list of names currently stored in the enrollment database. Use this when the user asks 'who do you know?', 'list users', or 'show me the database'.

function.name: describe_scene
function.description: Provides a general, high-level summary of what is visible in the camera frame. Use this for generic questions like 'what do you see?', 'describe the room', or 'what is in front of me?'. Do NOT use if the user asks to read text, count specific items, or identify a specific person by name.

function.name: take_photo
function.description: Captures and saves a still image file to the device storage. Use this when the user says 'take a picture', 'snap a photo', or 'capture this'.

function.name: get_camera_status
function.description: Reports technical health diagnostics of the camera (e.g., resolution, connection status, FPS). Use this when the user asks 'is the camera on?', 'check system status', or 'camera diagnostics'.

function.name: check_weather_outside
function.description: Retrieves current weather data (temperature, humidity, conditions) from sensors or a web service. Use this when the user asks 'what is the weather?', 'what's the temperature?', or 'is it raining?'.

function.name: check_air_quality
function.description: Measures air quality metrics such as CO2 levels and particulate matter (PM2.5). Use this when the user asks 'how is the air quality?', 'check CO2', or 'is the air safe?'.

function.name: list_capabilities
function.description: Returns a list of all available skills and commands the agent can perform. Use this when the user asks 'what can you do?', 'help', 'list commands', or 'show capabilities'.

function.name: await_specific_name
function.description: Starts a background monitor that alerts the user when a SPECIFIC enrolled person appears. Use this when the user says 'tell me when [Name] gets here', 'wait for [Name]', or 'alert me if [Name] arrives'.

name.description: The exact name of the enrolled person to look for.

function.name: await_general_entity
function.description: Starts a background monitor that alerts the user when a generic object or category appears (e.g., a dog, a car, a package). Use this when the user says 'tell me if you see a dog', 'wait for a car', or 'alert me when there is a package'.

entity.description: The object or category (e.g., 'dog', 'car', 'delivery truck') to monitor for.

function.name: count_general_entity
function.description: Counts the number of specific instances of an object visible RIGHT NOW in the current frame. Use this when the user asks 'how many people are there?', 'count the chairs', or 'how many dogs?'. This is an immediate action, not a background monitor.

function.name: estimate_distance
function.description: Estimates the physical distance in meters from the camera to a specific object. Use this when the user asks 'how far away is the door?', 'what is the distance to that car?', or 'is it close?'.

target.description: The object to measure distance to (e.g., 'door', 'person', 'tree').

function.name: add_face
function.description: Enrolls the person currently visible in the camera frame into the database with a specific name. Use this when the user says 'remember me', 'save this face as [Name]', or 'add user [Name]'.

name.description: The unique name to assign to the person being enrolled.

function.name: remove_face
function.description: Deletes a specific person from the enrollment database by their name. Use this when the user says 'forget [Name]', 'delete [Name]', or 'remove [Name]'.

name.description: The exact name of the person to remove from the database.

function.name: transcribe_speech
function.description: Records audio for a set duration and converts spoken words into text. Use this when the user says 'write down what I say', 'listen for 10 seconds', or 'transcribe audio'.

duration_seconds.description: The number of seconds to record audio (e.g., 5, 10, 30).

function.name: rename_face
function.description: Updates the label of an already enrolled user from an old name to a new name. Use this when the user says 'change [Name A] to [Name B]', 'rename [Name]', or 'update label'.

old_name.description: The current name of the enrolled face.

new_name.description: The new name to assign to the face.
